name: Izumi Meru
source:
Hobbies: Collecting shoujo manga, surfing the internet.
Likes: Animals (especially dogs).
Dislikes: Talking, wasting time.
How she treats the protagonist: She fawns over [url=/c12036]Akira[/url].

A girl who doesn't talk much with people or tries to get along with anybody. Meru is the poker face type, she almost never shows any emotion. Meru loves animals (especially dogs) because she doesn't have to talk to them. Her attitude softens when she is around Akira, because she somehow reminds her of a dog she used to have a long time ago. Due to this, Meru even nicknamed her after that dog, "Momo".

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=769298]Getchu[/url].]
